rdfs:label: hadGeneration
rdfs:comment: On a qualified prov:Derivation, links to the prov:Generation event in which the derived (output) entity was produced by the mediating activity.
notes: Domain `prov:Derivation`, range `prov:Generation`. Pair with `urn:solid:hadUsage` (the Usage of the input entity) and `urn:solid:hadActivity` to reconstruct exactly how one entity was derived from another through an activity. Not used on `prov:Usage` — PROV defines no Usage→Generation link.

examples.title: Qualified Derivation citing the Generation of the derived entity

history.note: Fixed domain to Derivation (was described on Usage); added domain/range; corrected example and seeAlso.
